Chassis perimeter.name: Chassis perimeter
Chassis perimeter.purpose: Tie the outer chassis together and back the bumper.
Chassis perimeter.rationale: The outer contour establishes the forward extension datum used to schedule the moving pivot.

Blue bumper set.name: Blue bumper set
Blue bumper set.material: Combined wood, foam and fabric envelope
Blue bumper set.rationale: Its full depth and height constrain the approach to a floor NOTE.

Bay crossmember \u00c2\u00b7 rear.name: Bay crossmember · rear
Bay crossmember \u00c2\u00b7 rear.purpose: Tie the two sills together and support the electrical deck.
Bay crossmember \u00c2\u00b7 rear.rationale: Moving the crossmembers inboard freed space for the rear drive motors.

Bay crossmember \u00c2\u00b7 front.name: Bay crossmember · front
Bay crossmember \u00c2\u00b7 front.purpose: Tie the two sills together and support the electrical deck.
Bay crossmember \u00c2\u00b7 front.rationale: Moving the crossmembers inboard freed space for the rear drive motors.

Chassis sill \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Chassis sill · left
Chassis sill \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Carry the pivot supports into the chassis.
Chassis sill \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: Two spaced longitudinal members give each support a direct footprint.

Pivot A-frame \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Pivot A-frame · left
Pivot A-frame \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Transfer cassette bearing loads into the sill.
Pivot A-frame \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The outboard legs straddle the centered NOTE path and spread the pivot reaction between two feet.

Slide base \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Slide base · left
Slide base \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Seat the linear guide on top of the pivot support.
Slide base \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The elevated rail lets the cassette translate above the bumper during rotation.

Slide guide \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Slide guide · left
Slide guide \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Constrain the translating bearing block to fore-aft travel.
Slide guide \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: Retraction through mid-swing is needed to stay within forward reach.

Translating bearing block \u00c2\u00b7 l.name: Translating bearing block · left
Translating bearing block \u00c2\u00b7 l.purpose: Move the pivot bearing with the linear carriage.
Translating bearing block \u00c2\u00b7 l.rationale: Both sides of the shaft must translate together to retain its axis.

Pivot bearing \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Pivot bearing · left
Pivot bearing \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The shaft needs a radial reaction on each side outside the piece channel.

Cassette cheek \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Cassette cheek · left

Cassette side beam \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: Keeping structure outboard leaves both runner surfaces clear for the NOTE.

Entry bearing bracket \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Carry the nose bearing and forward launch motor on a shared bracket.
Entry bearing bracket \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The upper motor location clears the front bumper at pickup. The integrated web preserves the entry-bearing bore.

Pivot torque shaft.name: Pivot torque shaft
Pivot torque shaft.purpose: Deliver pivot motor torque to both drums.
Pivot torque shaft.rationale: The shaft continues to turn while the cassette is locked.

Pivot reducer.name: Pivot reducer
Pivot reducer.material: Right-angle reducer envelope; motor on inboard-facing end
Pivot reducer.purpose: Convert motor speed into cassette pivot torque.
Pivot reducer.rationale: A right-angle package fits beside the moving carriage while preserving forward clearance.

Pivot motor.name: Pivot motor
Pivot motor.purpose: Rotate the loaded cassette between intake and aiming poses.
Pivot motor.rationale: The lift requires active torque against gravity, with holding capacity still to be verified.

Slide screw.name: Slide screw
Slide screw.purpose: Translate the pivot carriage fore and aft.
Slide screw.rationale: The scheduled shift removes the long fixed-pivot overreach.

Slide drive motor.name: Slide drive motor
Slide drive motor.rationale: The slide needs independently controlled movement as the pivot rotates.

Slide bearing mount -49.name: Slide bearing mount -49
Slide bearing mount -49.purpose: Locate the slide screw on the frame.
Slide bearing mount -49.rationale: The screw needs aligned end bearings across the translating stroke.

Slide bearing mount 220.name: Slide bearing mount 220
Slide bearing mount 220.purpose: Locate the slide screw on the frame.
Slide bearing mount 220.rationale: The screw needs aligned end bearings across the translating stroke.

Travel nut and clevis.name: Travel nut and clevis
Travel nut and clevis.purpose: Convert screw rotation into carriage travel.
Travel nut and clevis.rationale: The offset connection couples the translating truck to the outboard screw.

Runner crossbar 125.name: Runner crossbar 125
Runner crossbar 125.purpose: Join the two cassette beams and support the runner strips.
Runner crossbar 125.rationale: Spaced crossbars support the long sliding bed while clearing both belt drives.

Runner crossbar 370.name: Runner crossbar 370
Runner crossbar 370.purpose: Join the two cassette beams and support the runner strips.
Runner crossbar 370.rationale: Spaced crossbars support the long sliding bed while clearing both belt drives.

Runner crossbar 599.name: Runner crossbar 599
Runner crossbar 599.purpose: Join the two cassette beams and support the runner strips.
Runner crossbar 599.rationale: Spaced crossbars support the long sliding bed while clearing both belt drives.

Rear piece stop.name: Rear piece stop
Rear piece stop.purpose: Take the chambered NOTE load through a padded, replaceable stop.
Rear piece stop.rationale: Two rear-driven screws retain this backing against the bracket shoulders. The brackets land on the rear runner crossbar.

Nose roller shaft.name: Nose roller shaft
Nose roller shaft.purpose: Locate and drive the full-width nose roller.
Nose roller shaft.rationale: The shaft spans both entry brackets while leaving the pickup surface continuous.

Nose motor.name: Nose motor
Nose motor.material: Small geared motor; mount allowance open
Nose motor.purpose: Drive the nose roller during capture.
Nose motor.rationale: The entry contact needs torque before the ring reaches the opposed side belts.

Electronics deck.name: Electronics deck
Electronics deck.purpose: Mount the control and power equipment between the sills.
Electronics deck.rationale: A shared service plane separates the electronics from the rotating cassette.

Battery and terminal case.name: Battery and terminal case
Battery and terminal case.rationale: The installed envelope must accommodate the complete pack and a service withdrawal.

PDH.name: PDH
PDH.rationale: A placed distribution hub anchors the downstream power routing.

roboRIO flat.name: roboRIO flat
roboRIO flat.rationale: The control computer needs a mounted site and an allocation in each electrical duty.

radio.name: radio
radio.rationale: The real package reserves deck area and forms part of the continuous electrical load.

main breaker.name: main breaker
main breaker.purpose: Disconnect and protect the main battery circuit.
main breaker.rationale: Its installed location sets the route between the battery and distribution hub.

Pack lead.name: Pack lead
Pack lead.purpose: Reserve the cable route from the battery to the breaker.
Pack lead.rationale: The bend and terminals must fit beside the controls and disconnect for service.

Distribution lead.name: Distribution lead
Distribution lead.purpose: Reserve the main feed from the breaker to the distribution hub.
Distribution lead.rationale: A routed tube exposes bend and neighbor constraints that a schematic omits.

Nose pickup roller.name: Nose pickup roller
Nose pickup roller.material: Elastomer drum with relieved belt land
Nose pickup roller.purpose: Drive the wrapped center belt and present rolling surfaces on either side for an offset NOTE.
Nose pickup roller.rationale: The side belts alone cannot reach the ring at the initial approach.

Center intake belt.name: Center intake belt
Center intake belt.purpose: Catch the centered NOTE on the moving wrap around the nose and draw it toward the side belts.
Center intake belt.rationale: A continuous upper run replaces the gap between the powered nose and side belts.

Center belt idler.name: Center belt idler
Center belt idler.purpose: Return and tension the center belt.
Center belt idler.rationale: Bearing-mounted drum keeps the chamber end of the belt at runner height.

Center idler axle.name: Center idler axle
Center idler axle.purpose: React the idler load into its forks.
Center idler axle.rationale: A through axle supports the return drum at both ends.

Center idler fork \u00c2\u00b7 right.name: Center idler fork · right
Center idler fork \u00c2\u00b7 right.purpose: Mount the center idler axle to the runner crossbar.
Center idler fork \u00c2\u00b7 right.rationale: Bearing support sits outside the belt width.

Center idler fork \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Center idler fork · left
Center idler fork \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Mount the center idler axle to the runner crossbar.
Center idler fork \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: Bearing support sits outside the belt width.

Service index disk.name: Service index disk
Service index disk.purpose: Index the empty cassette during battery removal.
Service index disk.rationale: The second bore accepts the truck pin at −40°. The 80° service index traps the pack behind the new hoist rail.

Service pin guide.name: Service pin guide
Service pin guide.purpose: Support the locking pin outside the truck.
Service pin guide.rationale: Provides guidance through the aligned bore and clearance outside the pivot shaft.

Battery service pin.name: Battery service pin
Battery service pin.purpose: Manually pin the rotating disk before battery removal.
Battery service pin.rationale: Retracts 12 mm for motion. The selected service position is distinct from the obstructed launch angle.

Rear stop bracket \u00c2\u00b7 right.name: Rear stop bracket · right
Rear stop bracket \u00c2\u00b7 right.purpose: Transfer NOTE impact from the rear stop into the runner crossbar.
Rear stop bracket \u00c2\u00b7 right.rationale: The bent-up shoulder takes the rearward load. The lower return laps under the crossbar; the crossbar overlaps both cassette beams.

Rear stop bracket \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Rear stop bracket · left
Rear stop bracket \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Transfer NOTE impact from the rear stop into the runner crossbar.
Rear stop bracket \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The bent-up shoulder takes the rearward load. The lower return laps under the crossbar; the crossbar overlaps both cassette beams.

Rear stop screw \u00c2\u00b7 right.name: Rear stop screw · right
Rear stop screw \u00c2\u00b7 right.purpose: Clamp the removable stop backing to its bracket.
Rear stop screw \u00c2\u00b7 right.rationale: The screw enters from behind. The NOTE sees an uninterrupted padded face; thread engagement is a preliminary allocation.

Rear stop screw \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Rear stop screw · left
Rear stop screw \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Clamp the removable stop backing to its bracket.
Rear stop screw \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The screw enters from behind. The NOTE sees an uninterrupted padded face; thread engagement is a preliminary allocation.

Rear stop pad.name: Rear stop pad
Rear stop pad.purpose: Cushion the NOTE on arrival at the stop.
Rear stop pad.rationale: A replaceable 3 mm face covers the backing and separates the foam NOTE from metal hardware.

Stop bracket through bolt \u00c2\u00b7 r.name: Stop bracket through bolt · right
Stop bracket through bolt \u00c2\u00b7 r.purpose: Fasten the return of the stop bracket to the runner crossbar.
Stop bracket through bolt \u00c2\u00b7 r.rationale: A through joint gives the removable stop a positive connection under load in either direction.

Stop bracket locknut \u00c2\u00b7 right.name: Stop bracket locknut · right
Stop bracket locknut \u00c2\u00b7 right.purpose: Retain the crossbar through bolt under the stop bracket.
Stop bracket locknut \u00c2\u00b7 right.rationale: The nut bears on the underside of the bracket, leaving the runner lanes free.

Stop bracket through bolt \u00c2\u00b7 l.name: Stop bracket through bolt · left
Stop bracket through bolt \u00c2\u00b7 l.purpose: Fasten the return of the stop bracket to the runner crossbar.
Stop bracket through bolt \u00c2\u00b7 l.rationale: A through joint gives the removable stop a positive connection under load in either direction.

Stop bracket locknut \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Stop bracket locknut · left
Stop bracket locknut \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Retain the crossbar through bolt under the stop bracket.
Stop bracket locknut \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The nut bears on the underside of the bracket, leaving the runner lanes free.

Chambered NOTE.name: Chambered NOTE
Chambered NOTE.purpose: Represent the finite foam article through pickup, carry and discharge.
Chambered NOTE.rationale: Its ring geometry exposes lost powered contact and open escape paths in the cassette.

Lid post 95 \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Lid post 95 · left
Lid post 95 \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Support the keeper rails from the side beam.
Lid post 95 \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The post carries NOTE contact into the cassette instead of the thin panel edge.

Lid post 330 \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Lid post 330 · left
Lid post 330 \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Support the keeper rails from the side beam.
Lid post 330 \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The post carries NOTE contact into the cassette instead of the thin panel edge.

Lid edge rail \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Lid edge rail · left
Lid edge rail \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Seat the panel and support the flap axle.
Lid edge rail \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: The ledge bears under the cover along its edge and the upright wall carries the pivot.

Climb yoke post \u00c2\u00b7 left.name: Climb yoke post · left
Climb yoke post \u00c2\u00b7 left.purpose: Carry the chain reaction into the cassette side beam.
Climb yoke post \u00c2\u00b7 left.rationale: Places the crosspiece near the main pivot to limit required torque.

Lid post 95 \u00c2\u00b7 right.name: Lid post 95 · right
